metadata.title: Tight surgeries on torus knots
metadata.abstract: We give a complete classification of tight contact structures on manifolds obtained from any surgery along any torus knot, which provides the first such classification on an infinite family of knots. The main tools are the classification of non-loose torus knots, bordered contact invariants via their immersed curve interpretations, and non-thickenable tori in knot complements. As a byproduct of this classification, we also give the first classification of contact structures on some surface bundles over the circle with fibers of genus larger than $1$. The symplectic fillability of these contact structures is also studied and leads to, among other things, the disproof of a conjecture of Ghiggini and Van Horn-Morris on Stein fillability of some contact structures on a Brieskorn sphere.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.progressType: 所有环面结手术的 tight 接触结构分类
analysis.workSummary: 作者宣称分类任意环面结任意有理手术所得三维流形的 tight 接触结构至同痕。大部分手术区间给出闭式计数，正结的 [pq−p−q,pq−1) 与负结的 [pq−|q|,pq−1) 用分类算法计数，并研究 Stein、强辛和弱辛可填充性。
techniques: 边界接触不变量的浸入曲线表示
非增厚及部分增厚实心环面
analysis.breakthrough: 将以往缺失无穷多个手术斜率的分类补成覆盖整族环面结的完整框架。
analysis.limitations: 采用 |q|>p>0 的环面结约定；可填充性依赖结的符号和手术区间，不可把 tight 分类等同于所有结构均 Stein 可填充。

analysis.priorityReason: 低维接触拓扑中的完整无限族分类。
